title: This is a weird one that I had years ago, way before I found this sub, and always found fascinating
content: The mall I dream off often is very similar to an old mall here in my city that has been closed for a very long time now. It's two floors, white tile interior, glass windows in the high ceilings. It's almost always empty and in most of the dreams here I am able to remember the dream vividly and am roller blading around feeling pretty carefree. When I have dreams that are darker the mall itself becomes old, dingy, and crowded. But this one dream I had years ago was wild. I was the only one there and I came to a junction with a glass elevator and a water fountain thing. And I saw my Mom and Aunt there! I've never really interacted with anyone there and don't remember seeing any family. But they seemed just as excited to meet me and we seemed to all know it was a dream. I forget the exact conversation, but it basically ended up with my explaining where I was in life - I think I was about 36 at the time. And my Mom looks and me and goes "No way! *My* CaptainFuzzyBootz is 10!" And then my Aunt laughs and says "Ours is 23!" And I just had this vision of like parallel universes where I somehow existed in all of them and was meeting my actual family members from those different universes at various points in time. It was one of the coolest dreams I've ever had and part of me hopes those realities are out there somewhere and my Mom and Aunt are living their best lives there!
